Example BTK-MEGA-001 wh_jakarta UI: Tersedia=290 Incoming=800 Dipesan=98 → naive formula=992, actual ATP=653 (Δ=-339, likely 339 incoming beyond ATP horizon or additional backorder demand). Stok Fisik 968.03 vs Tersedia 310 + Dipesan 496.03 = 806.03 (Δ=162, likely karantina/blocked buckets not shown on main row). This is a transparency issue — users will not be able to reconcile numbers by eye. FULL POP-UP SWEEP: NOT PERFORMED comprehensively this run (would risk polluting data per agent-to-agent context note — strict read-only).
